title: Nanometer material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a nano material and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, connecting a graphite molded body and a conductive object which are respectively connected with a positive electrode and a negative electrode of a direct current power supply, placing the graphite molded body and the conductive object in electrolyte containing organic alkali, electrolyzing for 1-10 days under the voltage of 25-50V to obtain a first mixture containing carbon points and the organic alkali, S2, mixing a silicon source and an active center source, carrying out hydrothermal reaction on the obtained mixture and the first mixture to obtain a second mixture, S3, cooling the obtained reaction product, carrying out solid-liquid separation to obtain a solid-phase product and a liquid-phase product, roasting the solid-phase product to obtain the nano material, and S4, enabling the liquid-phase product to be in contact with a porous material, wherein the pore size of the porous material is larger than that of the nano material. The nano material prepared by the method not only has better catalytic reaction activity, but also can directly discharge the wastewater generated in the preparation process.

title: Nanometer material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method of preparing a nanomaterial and nanomaterial prepared by the method, the method comprising: a. preparing a carbon dot solution; b. uniformly mixing a silicon source, an active center source, organic alkali and optional water to obtain a first mixture; c. mixing the carbon dot solution with the first mixture to perform hydrolysis reaction to obtain a second mixture; d. and carrying out hydrothermal treatment on the second mixture, collecting a solid product, washing, drying and roasting to obtain the nano material. The nano material disclosed by the invention has excellent catalytic activity in the phenol oxidation reaction, and meanwhile, the catalytic stability and repeatability are good.

title: Carbon-coated Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 P 2 O 7 Material and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a carbon-coated Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 P 2 O 7 Material and preparation method thereof, and carbon-coated Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 P 2 O 7 The preparation method of the material comprises a dissolving step, and Fe (NO 3 ) 3 ·9H 2 0 is dissolved in deionized water, and citric acid is added to be fully stirredAfter that, naH is added 2 PO 4 Wherein Fe (NO) 3 ) 3 ·9H 2 0、NaH 2 PO 4 The ratio of the amount of the substances to the citric acid is (2.85-3.15): (3.9-4.3): (1.5-3.5); a drying step, namely drying the mixed solution obtained in the dissolving step to obtain a dried powder precursor; a heat treatment step, wherein the powder precursor is subjected to low-temperature solid phase reaction at 250-350 ℃ in inert atmosphere, and then subjected to high-temperature solid phase reaction at 450-700 ℃ to obtain the carbon-coated Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 P 2 O 7 A material. The preparation method can avoid synthesizing material Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 P 2 O 7 Contains Na 2 FeP 2 O 7 And NaFePO 4 And the impurity phases are equal, the phase purity is high, and the battery anode material has good electrochemical performance.

title: Electrode active material precursor and preparation method therefor, electrode active material and battery
abstract: Provided are an electrode active material precursor, a method for preparing the same, an electrode active material, and a battery. The electrode active material precursor includes carbon-composite oxide particles. The oxide satisfies a formula (1): M a O b (1), where element M is selected from one or more of transition metal elements having a relative atomic mass smaller than 65, and optionally being selected from one or more of Ni, Co, Fe, Mn, Zn, Mg, Ca, Cu, Mn, Sn, Mo, Ru, Ir, V, Nb, or Cr, a>0, and b>0. The carbon-composite oxide particles have a powder resistivity smaller than 100 Ω·cm.

title: Na 2 Fe(SO 4 ) 2 Preparation method of/C as composite positive electrode material of sodium-ion battery
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of sodium ion battery preparation, and particularly relates to Na 2 Fe(SO 4 ) 2 A preparation method of the composite positive electrode material of the sodium-ion battery; dispersing nano graphite in deionized water to obtain a mixed suspension; mixing sodium sulfate pentahydrate, ferrous sulfate heptahydrate and ascorbic acid according to a certain proportion, and spray-drying the nano graphite and Na 2 Fe(SO 4 ) 2 ·2H 2 O is tightly combined, the electrochemical performance of the material is greatly improved, the composite material is well coated by using a spray drying method, the conductivity of the material is improved, a precursor is synthesized by using a one-step method, the nano graphite and the precursor are mixed and spray dried, a three-dimensional spherical structure with uniform size is formed after spray drying, and the used medicine has the advantages of rich raw materials, low price and simple synthesis method.

title: Communication method and apparatus
abstract: This application provides a communication method and apparatus. The method includes: A network device sends first configuration information to a terminal device, where the first configuration information is used to configure that the terminal device reports one or more pieces of feedback information, the feedback information is used to describe measurement information of N reference signals, each of the N reference signals corresponds to one resource, resources corresponding to the N reference signals belong to a same resource set, each piece of feedback information corresponds to one resource set, the feedback information includes N information groups, an n th information group in the N information groups includes a measurement result of an n th reference signal and/or an identifier of a resource corresponding to the n th reference signal, N is an integer greater than or equal to 1, and n∈[1, N].

title: Computing device, data processing method and system, and related device
abstract: A computing device and a data processing method and system are provided. The computing device includes a central processing unit, at least one heterogeneous device, and a shared memory pool. The central processing unit is configured to: divide the shared memory pool into a plurality of memory spaces, store, in a first memory space in the plurality of memory spaces, first to-be-processed data that is provided by a client and that is associated with a service, and notify a first heterogeneous device of an address of the first to-be-processed data in the first memory space and a first operation that needs to be performed by the first heterogeneous device. The first heterogeneous device performs the first operation on the first to-be-processed data, and stores obtained first data in a second memory space. According to the method, the heterogeneous device does not need to perform data movement on the first to-be-processed data between different memories, but can directly process the first to-be-processed data in the shared memory pool, thereby avoiding problems of high resource consumption and a high service processing delay.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and program
abstract: There is provided an information processing apparatus, an information processing method, and a program that make it possible to recognize a state of telecommunication among multiple points more easily. Information regarding telecommunication performed among telecommunication apparatuses is received, and an image that indicates a state of telecommunication between a first telecommunication apparatus and another communication apparatus and a state of telecommunication between a plurality of other telecommunication apparatuses is generated on the basis of the received information, and then the generated image is displayed. The present disclosure can be applied, for example, to an information processing apparatus, a telecommunication apparatus, electronic equipment, an information processing method, a program, or the like.

title: Radio communication apparatus, method of processing reception signal, and non-transitory computer readable medium storing program
abstract: A radio communication apparatus ( 100 ) according to the present disclosure includes a first frequency domain conversion unit ( 1 ) configured to convert a reception signal into a first frequency domain signal, a bandwidth restriction unit ( 2 ) configured to restrict a bandwidth by extracting a first number of points corresponding to a frequency bandwidth of a desired signal from the first frequency domain signal, a time domain conversion unit ( 3 ) configured to convert the signal with the restricted bandwidth into a time domain signal with the first number of points, a symbol reconstruction unit ( 4 ) configured to reconstruct symbols from the time domain signal, and a second frequency domain conversion unit ( 5 ) configured to convert each of the reconstructed symbols into a second frequency domain signal with the first number of points. Thus, a radio communication apparatus that can efficiently perform signal processing is provided.

title: Apparatus, computer readable medium, and method for changing service using advanced data collection capability
abstract: A method for presenting services to a subscriber includes a specific process. The method includes collecting usage data associated with an account of a subscriber associated with a portable device. The method includes storing the usage data in an information repository. The method includes determining whether the usage data satisfies a condition. The method includes determining whether there is data for an actionable category. The method includes determining an action based on the actionable category of data and a set of rules. The method includes receiving a first message from a portable device, the first message indicating that a communication function of the portable device has terminated. The method includes sending a second message to the portable device, the second message requesting input from the subscriber via the portable device, and the second message being based on an action. The method includes receiving a third message from the portable device, the third message including a response to the second message.

title: Electro-optical device and electronic device
abstract: An electro-optical device includes a first member having a translucent property, a second member having a translucent property and opposed to the first member with a space being disposed therebetween, and a plurality of pixel electrodes provided at an opposite side from the first member with respect to the second member. The first member includes a substrate body. The second member includes a transparent film. A plurality of lens surfaces having a protruding curved surface and each overlapping, in plan view, with corresponding one of the plurality of pixel electrodes are formed at a surface of the second member that is opposed to the first member. A pillar that extends through the space and is in contact with the first member and the second member is provided between the first member and the second member. The space can be formed by removing a sacrificial layer provided between the first member and the second member.

title: Electronic device
abstract: An electronic device includes a light guide plate, a plurality of light sources, a plastic frame and at least an optical film. The light guide plate includes a first terminal and a second terminal opposite to the first terminal. The plurality of light sources are disposed adjacent to the second terminal and are arranged along the first direction. The plastic frame is disposed adjacent to the first terminal. One of the at least an optical film includes a body part and a protrude part connected to the body part, and the protrude part is fixed on the plastic frame, the body part includes a first side adjacent to the plastic frame, and in a second direction, a shortest distance between the first side and the plastic film is in a range between 0 to 0.4 mm.

title: Electronic device
abstract: An electronic device is provided. The electronic device includes a substrate, a semiconductor unit, a wall, and a light-transmitting member. The semiconductor unit is mounted on the substrate. The wall is disposed on the substrate and surrounds the semiconductor unit. The wall includes two exterior wall components and two interior wall components. The two exterior wall components are spaced apart from each other, so that two gaps are formed between the two exterior wall components. The two gaps are in spatial communication with an installation area that is surrounded by the two exterior wall components. The two interior wall components are arranged in the installation area and spaced apart from each other. The two interior wall components correspond in position to the two gaps and respectively shade parts of the two gaps. The light-transmitting member is disposed on the wall and covered on the semiconductor unit.

title: Array substrate, manufacturing method thereof and display panel
abstract: The invention discloses an array substrate, a manufacturing method thereof and a display panel, wherein the array substrate comprises: a substrate; a first metal layer disposed on the substrate, the first metal layer including a source electrode; the first insulating layer covers the source electrode, and a through hole is formed in the position, corresponding to the source electrode, of the first insulating layer; a first transparent conductive layer disposed on the first insulating layer, the first transparent conductive layer including a pixel electrode; a second metal layer arranged on the first insulating layer and the pixel electrode, wherein the second metal layer comprises a drain electrode; the semiconductor layer is arranged on the drain electrode and is filled in the through hole to electrically connect the source electrode and the drain electrode; a second insulating layer covering the pixel electrode and the semiconductor layer; a gate electrode disposed on the second insulating layer; a third insulating layer covering the gate electrode; and a second transparent conductive layer disposed on the third insulating layer, the second transparent conductive layer including a common electrode. The array substrate provided by the invention not only reduces the power consumption, but also avoids the influence on the conductivity of the semiconductor layer after light irradiates the semiconductor layer.

title: Light-emitting substrate and display apparatus
abstract: A light-emitting substrate and a display apparatus. The light-emitting substrate comprises at least one light-emitting device, wherein each light-emitting device comprises a first electrode, a second electrode, a first light-emitting unit, a second light-emitting unit and a charge generation layer. The first light-emitting unit comprises a first light-emitting layer and a first blocking layer located on the side of the first light-emitting layer that is close to the first electrode, and the second light-emitting unit comprises a second light-emitting layer and a second blocking layer located on the side of the second light-emitting layer that is away from the second electrode, the material of the second blocking layer comprising a blocking host material and a blocking guest material. A light-emergent side of the light-emitting substrate is located on the side of the second electrode that is away from the first electrode, the value of the ratio of the distance between the second light-emitting layer and the second electrode to the distance between the first electrode and the second electrode ranges from 10% to 25%, and the value of the ratio of the distance between the first light-emitting layer and the first electrode to the distance between the first electrode and the second electrode ranges from 10% to 30%. Therefore, the light-emitting substrate has a higher level of light-emitting efficiency and a longer service life.

title: Ai discernment long-range real-time supervision device
abstract: The utility model provides an Ai discernment long-range real-time supervision device relates to monitoring facilities technical field, including the work casing, the position fixedly connected with camera is close to the top on work casing front surface, the position fixedly connected with control switch is close to the middle part on work casing front surface, the work casing lower surface has seted up the interface that charges, the work casing upper surface has seted up the data interface, the work casing rear surface symmetry is provided with the connecting plate; the utility model discloses a control switch is opened to top center fixedly connected with receiving module in the work casing, monitors the work through the camera to monitoring range, and the data transfer that the camera was gathered gives processing module, and processing module compares data transfer for work module, and data through work module position and storage module confirms that safety then continues to monitor the work, if dangerous, then uploads alarm signal through signal transmission module to promote terminal staff and notice the tour.

title: Safety monitoring device based on artificial intelligence
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety monitoring devices, and particularly relates to a safety monitoring device based on artificial intelligence, which comprises a device main body, wherein a lifter is arranged in the device main body, a camera is arranged at the bottom of the lifter, an electric heating fan is arranged on the front surface of the device main body, a protective cover is arranged at the top of the device main body, and smoke bomb starters are arranged on two sides of the device main body; according to the safety monitoring device based on artificial intelligence, the camera can be stored into the device main body for protection when the device is in standby or bad weather such as hail occurs by using the lifter, the camera can be dried by using hot air when the surface of the screen of the camera is fogged by using the electric heating fan, the device main body and the monitoring host can be effectively protected by using the buffer shaft and the protective cover, and the device can give an alarm to the surroundings in time for warning when a potential safety hazard is found by using the loudspeaker and the smoke bomb starter, and can also send signal smoke to the sky in cooperation with the signal smoke bomb.

title: Monitoring controller for road vehicle safety
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of monitoring controllers, in particular to a monitoring controller for the safety of highway vehicles, which comprises a support column, a storage box and a warning lamp, wherein the storage box is arranged at the lower side in the support column, the upper side in the storage box is fixedly connected with a medical box, the lower side in the storage box is fixedly connected with a road equipment box, the front side of the storage box is rotatably connected with a box door, and the middle position of the right front side of the box door is fixedly connected with a handle; the utility model discloses in, through the support column that sets up, baffle, monitor, solar panel and warning light, this kind of being provided with does benefit to protection monitor and supervisory control ware, prevents monitor and supervisory control ware impaired influence monitoring effect, the warning rear vehicle of being convenient for of setting up of warning light reminds rear vehicle the place ahead vehicle to appear colliding carefully driving, effectively reduces secondary collision's emergence, solar panel can absorb solar energy and turn into the electric energy storage and use in the battery monitoring devices altogether, energy saving and emission reduction.

title: Intelligent analysis system and method for communication data
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent analysis system and method for communication data, which relate to the technical field of data transmission, wherein the system comprises the steps of acquiring an intelligent household equipment list; the method comprises the steps of obtaining target household scene information interactively, carrying out equipment application analysis on the target household scene information to obtain a target application household equipment set, constructing a communication analysis cloud, carrying out matching mapping and resource analysis on a household equipment control model group to obtain a target equipment control model set, and carrying out communication control on the target application household equipment set based on a household equipment control parameter set. Solves the technical problems that the prior household equipment communication data analysis has insufficient data island and equipment compatibility, so that the user needs are difficult to be matched accurately, and the analysis processing of the communication data is not accurate, comprehensive and intelligent, the intelligent household device has the advantages that the comprehensive capture, intelligent analysis and accurate control of communication data among intelligent household devices are realized, and the technical effects of improving the analysis accuracy and the intellectualization of the communication data are achieved.

title: Power utilization safety inspection system and analysis method
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of power equipment inspection, and provides an electricity safety inspection system and an analysis method, wherein the system comprises a cloud service platform and at least one wearable inspection device, the wearable inspection device is provided with a wearing bracket, the front end of the wearing bracket is provided with a display lens and a depth camera lens, the wearing bracket is provided with a device positioning module, a wireless transmission module and a device safety identification processing module, and the device safety identification processing module comprises: an input unit; an operation and storage unit; a virtual object database; a deficiency-excess fusion mechanism; and an output unit. The embodiment of the invention can quickly identify and analyze the cable and the meter, visually display the inspection personnel through the virtual-real fused image, greatly improve the efficiency of the inspection personnel, improve the accuracy of safety inspection, reduce the labor cost and time cost, and simultaneously seek remote or on-site assistance when independent processing cannot be carried out.

title: Active polypeptide, preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparation of product for relieving and/or treating liver injury
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly discloses a preparation method of an active polypeptide, which comprises the following steps: s11, taking fresh animal bone marrow, adding water, and uniformly stirring to obtain a bone marrow mixed solution; s12, adding protease into the bone marrow mixed liquor for enzymolysis, inactivating the protease after the enzymolysis is finished, and filtering to remove precipitates to obtain an enzymolysis liquid; s13, dialyzing the enzymatic hydrolysate by using a first dialysis bag to obtain first dialysate and first cut-off liquid; s14, dialyzing the first dialysate by using a second dialysis bag to obtain a second dialysate and a second trapped fluid; and concentrating and drying the second trapped fluid to obtain the active polypeptide. The active polypeptide of the composition and tremella polysaccharide. Research shows that the active polypeptide and the composition have excellent effect of treating liver injury; therefore, the compound has important application value as an effective component for developing functional food, dietary supplement or medicament for relieving and/or treating liver injury.

title: Pharmaceutical composition containing tag-anti-human antibody Fab fragment complex
abstract: The present invention provides stable pharmaceutical compositions and the like containing a tag-anti-human antibody Fab fragment complex. In a pharmaceutical composition containing a labeling-anti-human antibody Fab fragment complex, citric acid, phosphoric acid, 2- [4- (2-hydroxyethyl) -1-piperazinyl ] ethanesulfonic acid or tris (hydroxymethyl) aminomethane are blended as a buffer, sucrose or glycerol are blended as a stabilizer, and a nonionic surfactant is blended, and the pH is adjusted to 6.5 to 7.5. Thus, the generation of multimeric and insoluble microparticles can be suppressed when the labeling unit-anti-human antibody Fab fragment complex is stored.

title: Cationic lipid compound, preparation method thereof, composition containing cationic lipid compound and application of cationic lipid compound
abstract: The invention provides a cationic lipid compound, a preparation method thereof, a composition containing the cationic lipid compound and application of the cationic lipid compound, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines. The cationic lipid compound has a structure represented by formula (I): One or more of R 1 、R 2 、R 3 are each independently selected from secondary or tertiary amines, the remainder each independently selected from C 3 ～C 30 straight or branched saturated or unsaturated hydrocarbyl; L 1 、L 2 are each independently selected from a single bond, or a C 1 ～C 20 saturated or unsaturated alkylene, the q methylene groups of L 1 and/or L 2 are each independently replaced by-O-, -C (O) -or-C (O) O-; the q methylene groups of L 1 and/or L 2 are each independently replaced by-O-, -C (O) -or-C (O) O-substitution.

title: Application of polypeptide in preparing medicine for treating type 2 immune disease
abstract: The invention discloses the use of a polypeptide comprising an amino acid sequence as shown in SEQ ID No.3, or a fragment, variant, fusion or derivative thereof, or a fusion of said fragment, variant or derivative thereof, in the manufacture of a medicament for the treatment of type 2 immune disorders. The invention provides a new method for preventing or treating type 2 immune diseases, and has potential clinical application value. The invention also discloses a method for detecting the Charcot-Laiden crystal.

title: Polypeptide and application thereof
abstract: The invention provides a polypeptide and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of biological medicines. The invention discloses a polypeptide with a brand new amino acid structure, and the amino acid sequence of the polypeptide is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1. The polypeptide provided by the invention can obviously reduce the paralysis rate of transgenic CL4176 nematodes, has obvious activity of resisting Alzheimer disease, and has obvious inhibition effect on the secretion of IgE by U266 cells, and the polypeptide can further realize antiallergic effect by inhibiting the generation of IgE. The polypeptide provided by the invention is expected to be used as a novel medicine for resisting Alzheimer disease or treating anaphylaxis.

title: Driving assembly and positioning device
abstract: Aiming at the problem that in the prior art, machining scraps easily enter a cylinder to cause easy blocking of a piston and a guide rod of the machining scraps, the utility model provides a driving assembly and a positioning device. The cover body is a drawer cover body structure and is arranged on the bottom plate. A cavity is formed between the cover body and the bottom plate, and the cylinder is fixed in the cavity. The starting end of the sliding block is connected with the guide rod of the air cylinder, and the tail end of the sliding block extends along the extending direction of the guide rod of the air cylinder and penetrates out of the cover body; the tail end of the sliding block is used for connecting the leaning angle. The sliding block is in sliding fit with the cover body and is sealed. Therefore, the problem that machining scraps enter the cylinder to cause clamping can be solved.

title: Manual formula elevating gear for new material processing production
abstract: The invention discloses a lifting device for manual new material processing production, which adopts the technical scheme that: the cutting device comprises a lifting device, a cutting device and a cutting table, wherein the lifting device is fixedly installed on the inner wall of one end of the cutting table, the cutting table is close to a fixed installation support at the top of one end of the lifting device, the support is close to a fixed installation chute at one end of the lifting device, the lifting device is fixedly installed at one end of the chute, the cutting device is fixedly installed at the bottom of one end, away from the chute, of the lifting device, the lifting device comprises a bearing, the bearing is fixedly installed on the inner wall of one end of the cutting table, a threaded rod is connected to the inner wall of the bearing, an internal thread cylinder is fixedly installed on the outer wall of one end of the threaded rod, a: the novel material cutting device is favorable for realizing free up-and-down movement of the cutting device, so that the novel material cutting effect is good, and convenience is provided for subsequent processing of the novel material.

title: Protective device for machining mechanical equipment
abstract: The utility model relates to a protective device for machining mechanical equipment, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein a movable wheel is arranged at the bottom end of the supporting plate, a lifting groove is formed in the supporting plate, a lifting plate is arranged in the lifting groove in a lifting adjustable manner, a lifting adjusting structure is arranged between the lifting plate and the supporting plate, an observation window is arranged on the lifting plate, a collecting box is arranged below the inner side wall of the supporting plate, a discharging pipe is arranged at the bottom end of the collecting box in an outward extending manner, a spiral discharging shaft is arranged in the collecting box through a bearing and matched with the discharging pipe, a driving piece is arranged on the collecting box in a transmission connection with the spiral discharging shaft, an electromagnet is arranged on the inner wall of the supporting plate in a matched manner, and the electromagnet is connected with a power supply structure.

title: Device is used in elevator accessory production and processing
abstract: The utility model discloses a device is used in elevator accessory production and processing, which comprises a platform, the bottom fixed mounting of platform has four landing legs that are two bisymmetry settings, the top central point of platform puts and has seted up the mounting hole, rotate through the bearing in the mounting hole and install the pivot, the both ends of pivot all extend to outside the mounting hole, there is first motor bottom the platform through support fixed mounting, the bottom of pivot and the output shaft end fixed connection of first motor, the top fixed mounting of pivot has the backup pad, the top fixed mounting of backup pad has electric putter, electric putter's output shaft end fixed mounting has the connecting seat. The utility model relates to a rationally, the practicality is good, can carry out spraying anti-rust paint to the surface of elevator accessory automatically to can heat to dry automatically the elevator accessory surface of spraying good paint, accelerate the solidification of anti-rust paint, not only reduce staff's the amount of labour, still improve work efficiency.

title: General quick feeding and discharging pressing mechanism
abstract: The utility model provides a universal quick feeding and discharging pressing mechanism, which aims to solve the problems of inconvenient feeding and discharging of materials and unstable fixation of the tool. The pressing mechanism comprises a fixed block, the fixed block is connected with a compression spring, the upper end of the compression spring is connected with a pressing claw, the lower end of the pressing claw is provided with a pressing claw connecting pin, the pressing claw is clung to a pressing plate, the pressing plate is provided with a pressing plate connecting pin, the pressing plate connecting pin is connected with a height adjusting plate, the height adjusting plate is provided with a screw hole, and the screw penetrates through the screw hole to connect the tool main body with the height adjusting plate. Through a generalized design, can be used to the quick unloading of material of various frock compress tightly, flattening material, improve production efficiency, especially improve the reliability that water gauge photoelectric coding character wheel subassembly electrical property detected.

title: Air treatment device based on clean room system
abstract: The utility model relates to an air purification handles technical field, specifically is an air treatment device based on clean room system, include: the box body is internally provided with a filter plate, the right side wall of the box body is provided with a second mounting groove, the stop rod is connected with a telescopic spring and a fixed block, and the movable rod is connected with a return spring and a baffle; the beneficial effects are that: at first, press the clamp plate, make the movable rod drive reset spring and stretch, make the baffle extrude the fixed block, thereby make fixed block extrusion expanding spring shrink, the one end that has the fillet with the fixed block separates with mounting groove two and shrinks mounting groove one, elastic action through sealing rubber pad on the pin lateral wall is popped out the pin from the square hole slowly afterwards, at last pulling filter, and through the slip between slider and the spout, so that dismantle the filter from the box inside fast.

title: Environmental protection equipment for treating industrial waste gas
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of waste gas treatment, in particular to an environment-friendly device for treating industrial waste gas, which comprises a heat recovery mechanism, wherein the heat recovery mechanism comprises an absorption tower internally provided with a cavity, a water conveying cavity, a heat absorption cavity and a water inlet cavity are sequentially arranged in the absorption tower from top to bottom, a heat absorption pipe for connecting the water conveying cavity and the water inlet cavity is arranged in the heat absorption cavity, and the side walls at the upper end and the lower end of the heat absorption cavity are respectively provided with a water outlet pipe and a water inlet pipe which are communicated with the heat absorption cavity; an air inlet pipe is arranged at the upper end of the water inlet cavity, a water conveying pipeline for communicating the water inlet cavity with the water conveying cavity is arranged between the water inlet cavity and the water conveying cavity, one end of the water conveying pipeline extends into the bottom end of the water inlet cavity, and the end part of the water conveying pipeline, which is positioned at the bottom end of the water inlet cavity, is connected with a water pump; the pipeline at the upper end part of the water delivery cavity is connected with a waste gas filtering mechanism. The utility model discloses a heat recovery mechanism structure's setting has not only realized still having promoted the filter effect to waste gas to the recycle of the energy in the waste gas.

title: Heat treatment equipment with rapid quenching function
abstract: The utility model relates to a thermal treatment equipment technical field discloses a thermal treatment equipment with rapid quenching function, comprising a base plate, the equal fixedly connected with support column in top middle part left and right sides of bottom plate, the top rear side fixedly connected with electric putter of bottom plate, two the top sliding connection of support column has the protective cover, fixedly connected with sliding block in the bottom of protective cover, the equal fixedly connected with connecting block in bottom left and right sides of sliding block, two the bottom fixedly connected with guard plate of connecting block, the inboard front end top of guard plate rotates and is connected with the dwang, the outside of dwang is rotated and is connected with the baffle. The utility model discloses in, put into the inside in quenching groove through placing the mouth with the article of required quenching and quench, after quenching is accomplished, start electric putter and make it promote protective cover 4 and slide on the support column to drive the sliding block, drive the connecting block by the sliding block again.

title: Device suitable for tail gas heat transfer cooling
abstract: The utility model discloses a device suitable for heat exchange and cooling of tail gas, which comprises a treatment box, wherein one end of the treatment box is provided with an air inlet, a plurality of baffles are arranged in the treatment box, so that a curved airflow channel is formed in the treatment box, a radiating fin tube is arranged in the airflow channel, a water storage room is arranged at the bottom of the treatment box, one side of the treatment box is provided with an air outlet channel, a packing layer is arranged in the air outlet channel, a spraying mechanism is arranged above the packing layer, a fan is connected above the air outlet channel, and the fan is connected with an air outlet. The utility model has reasonable structural design, the baffle plate is arranged in the treatment box to form a curved airflow channel, so that the hot airflow and the radiating fin tube can be fully contacted, the cooling effect is far superior to that of common dust removing equipment, and the dust removal and the cooling effect are good by adopting a plurality of groups of filler layers.

title: Purifying device for boiler waste gas treatment
abstract: The utility model discloses a purification device for boiler waste gas treatment, which comprises a first box body, wherein one side of the first box body is fixedly communicated with an air inlet pipe, one end of the first box body, which is positioned at the air inlet pipe, is fixedly communicated with a dust removing cloth bag, the top of the first box body is fixedly communicated with a connecting pipe, one end of the connecting pipe is fixedly communicated with a second box body, the top of the second box body is provided with a spraying assembly, the inner wall of the second box body is provided with a groove, the inside of the groove is detachably provided with a mounting plate, the inside of the mounting plate is provided with a filter screen, one side, which is positioned below the filter screen, of the second box body is fixedly communicated with a liquid inlet pipe, dust particles in the sprayed adsorption liquid are filtered through the filter screen, the adsorption liquid is recycled through a water pump, the adsorption capacity of the adsorption liquid is ensured, and the stability of the device is improved.

title: Curable composition, and cured product
abstract: Provided are: a curable composition containing a heat-conductive filler (A), including at least one selected from the group consisting of heat-conductive fillers A having a volume average particle size of 0.3 μm to less than 1 μm and heat-conductive fillers B having a volume average particle size of 1 μm to less than 10 μm, and a heat-conductive filler C having a volume average particle size of 10-15 μm (inclusive), a monomer (B) having a (meth)acryloyl group, a polymerization initiator (C), and a dispersant (D), based on the total mass of the heat-conductive filler (A), the content X of the heat-conductive filler A being 0-40 mass%, the content Y of the heat-conductive filler B being 0-40 mass%, and the content Z of the heat-conductive filler C being 20-60 mass% (where, content X and content Y are not both 0 mass%); and a cured product thereof.

title: Resin composition, cured product, prepreg, metal foil-clad laminate, resin composite sheet, printed wiring board, and semiconductor device
abstract: The present invention provides a resin composition, a cured product, a prepreg, a metal foil-clad laminate, a resin composite sheet, a printed wiring board, and a semiconductor device. The resin composition contains an elastomer (A), a compound (B) represented by formula (GU), and a radical polymerization initiator (C). The elastomer (A) includes a polymer block (a1) containing a conjugated diene compound unit and a styrene compound unit having a radical reactive group. The content of the elastomer (A) is 1-30 parts by mass with respect to 100 parts by mass of the resin solid content. In formula (GU), R 1 and R 2 are hydrogen atoms or substituents, two R 2 are the same as each other, at least one of R 1 and R 2 is a group including a (meth)allyl group, and R 3 and R 4 each independently represent a hydrogen atom, an alkyl group, or an aryl group.

title: Composition, preparation method thereof and carrier
abstract: The disclosure provides a composition, a preparation method thereof and a carrier, and belongs to the technical field of high polymer materials. The composition comprises, by mass, 50% -85% of cycloolefin resin, 3% -25% of a first thermoplastic elastomer, 10% -25% of a second thermoplastic elastomer and 0.3% -8% of a conductive filler. The first thermoplastic elastomer comprises a thermoplastic elastomer and a polar monomer grafted to the thermoplastic elastomer, wherein the polar monomer comprises at least one of maleic anhydride, itaconic anhydride, citraconic anhydride, crotonic anhydride, acrylic acid, methacrylic acid, methyl acrylate, ethyl acrylate, methyl methacrylate, ethyl methacrylate and glycidyl methacrylate. The second thermoplastic elastomer includes a styrene segment as a repeating unit. The material of the composition has the characteristics of low moisture absorption, high heat resistance, high cleanliness, high mechanical strength and antistatic property.

title: Chemically cured water-based 2-component compositions
abstract: The present invention relates to a two-component composition comprising: A) a first component a comprising: -an aqueous dispersion of at least one polymer P1; B) a second component B comprising: -at least one hydraulic binder H, -at least one functional compound P2; wherein both components a and B are liquid or pasty and both are prepared and stored separately and mixed directly before application; and with the proviso that the functional compound P2 comprises a functional group which chemically reacts with said aqueous dispersion of said first polymer P1 to form a crosslinked and/or chain-extended polymer. The compositions of the present invention are highly suitable cementitious adhesives, joint sealants, casting compositions or coatings and exhibit improved mechanical properties, adhesive properties and resistance and minimized plasticizer migration problems.

title: Heat-curable resin composition, and adhesive agent, film, prepreg, laminate, circuit board and printed-wiring board using same
abstract: Provided are a heat-curable resin composition capable of being turned into a cured product having a high glass-transition temperature, a low dielectric tangent and a superior adhesion to a metal foil; and an adhesive agent, film, prepreg, laminate, circuit board as well as printed-wiring board using such heat-curable resin composition. The heat-curable resin composition contains: (A) a polyphenylene ether resin having reactive double bonds at molecular chain ends; (B) a (meth)acrylic acid ester compound; (C) a cyclic imide compound containing, in one molecule, at least one dimer acid backbone, at least one linear alkylene group having not less than 6 carbon atoms, and at least two cyclic imide groups; and (D) a reaction initiator.

title: Scroll compressor, vehicle air conditioner and vehicle
abstract: Scroll compressor, a vehicle air conditioner and a vehicle are disclosed. The scroll compressor includes a first end cover, a casing and a crankshaft. The casing is provided with a supporting portion having a first bearing mounting portion; the first end cover is provided with a second bearing mounting portion; a first end of the crankshaft is arranged in the first bearing mounting portion through a first bearing; a second end of the crankshaft is arranged in the second bearing mounting portion through a second bearing; and the first bearing mounting portion and the second bearing mounting portion cooperate with each other to form an axial limitation on the crankshaft.

title: Arm-type electronic sphygmomanometer convenient to accomodate
abstract: The utility model discloses an arm type electronic sphygmomanometer convenient to store, and relates to the technical field of medical appliances; including host computer and sleeve area, the host computer includes organism, display screen, function button, power source, battery and loudspeaker, and the display screen is located the organism surface, and the side of display screen is located to the function button, and power source locates the side of organism, in the battery was located the organism, the back of organism was located to loudspeaker, and the sleeve area includes arm area, air hose and air plug, and the arm area is taken over the air hose and is connected with the organism, and the organism periphery is equipped with the standing groove, and the organism side is equipped with the take-in plate. According to the arm-type electronic sphygmomanometer convenient to store, the placing groove is formed in the periphery of the body, so that the air hose is placed in the placing groove, and the hose is convenient to store; the storage plate is arranged on the side surface of the machine body, so that the arm belt is placed in the storage plate, and the arm belt is conveniently stored; the sleeve belt is not required to be stored independently, the plug is not required to be plugged and unplugged frequently, the air hose is not easy to wear, the air hose is not easy to damage, and the measurement stability is good.

title: Carbon fiber/phenolic resin reinforced composite material based on conductive network
abstract: The invention relates to a carbon fiber/phenolic resin reinforced composite material based on a conductive network, which comprises the following raw materials: carbon fiber materials, phenolic resin and nano conductive carbon materials; the nano conductive carbon material is deposited on the surface of the carbon fiber through electrochemistry and is physically dispersed in the phenolic resin; the carbon fiber/phenolic resin reinforced composite material based on the conductive network is obtained by coating phenolic resin containing nano conductive carbon materials on carbon fiber materials modified by the nano conductive carbon materials and then performing hot-pressing curing; the nano conductive carbon material is a compound of a carbon nano tube and graphene. The invention not only improves the interface bonding force of the carbon fiber/phenolic resin composite material, but also further enhances the mechanical and electrical coupling performance of the composite material. Meanwhile, the relationship among the material structure, the mechanical property and the electrical property is established through the resistance measurement result, and a new idea is provided for the electrical impedance measurement technology of the composite material.

title: Battery manufacturing method and battery manufacturing system
abstract: A battery manufacturing method according to the present disclosure may comprise the steps of: generating a virtual ID corresponding to a battery cell; shifting the virtual ID according to the progress of a step for the battery cell; matching and storing the shifted virtual ID and step data generated for the battery cell; extracting a cell ID for the battery cell; and matching the step data matched with the virtual ID corresponding to the cell ID with the cell ID and transmitting the matched step data to a higher control system.

title: Digestion object analysis device
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical equipment, and particularly relates to a digest analysis device which comprises a machine body and a touch screen, wherein a baffle is symmetrically arranged on the outer side of the touch screen, a top plate is arranged above the baffle and fixedly connected with the machine body, a transmission mechanism is arranged above the top plate and comprises a synchronous right-angle speed reducer arranged on the upper surface of the top plate, a transmission shaft arranged at the power input end of the synchronous right-angle speed reducer through a coupler, a driven gear arranged at the outer wall of the transmission shaft, a servo motor arranged on one side of the transmission shaft, a driving gear arranged at the power output end of the servo motor and meshed with the driven gear, and an infrared human body proximity switch is arranged below the baffle.
